create_TorchrecStrategy: create a TorchrecStrategy instance to bypass Lightning DDP logic for torchrec models
broadcast_object: broadcast a tensor or object across distributed processes using TorchrecStrategy broadcast method
save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint to a file path using TorchrecStrategy save_checkpoint method

reduce_tensor: reduce a tensor across all processes using TorchrecStrategy reduce method with all_reduce
